threshold.quote: The model provides meaningful uplift to a low-to-medium skilled actor’s ability to create and conduct highly disruptive or destructive cyber-attacks, including on critical infrastructure

response.quote: Models posing high-risk on one or more tracked high-risk capability will be subject to security measures protective against most cybercrime groups and insider threats.
response.note: Also pause sentence p.9; table says 'Further review and mitigations required' (unnamed) but p.8 names restricted access, weight encryption, defense in depth.

acc_decider.quote: The Executive Officers (or their delegates) will make the final decision on whether to approve the recommendation for secure and trustworthy deployment.
acc_decider.note: Executive Officers responsible for the AI governance program; role-based, not a named individual.

acc_external.note: Ambiguous: p.7 'We engage qualified third parties to conduct evaluations' but third parties conduct evaluations is discretionary: 'sometimes', and internal experts decide whether to involve them (p.7); security red teaming by third parties is 'where appropriate' (p.8). No binding external review.

acc_unmet.quote: If, during the implementation of this framework, we identify a risk we cannot sufficiently mitigate, we will pause development and deployment until the point at which mitigation practices evolve to meet the risk.
acc_unmet.note: Pause until mitigation meets the risk; required response is the mitigations and security measures.

mentioned.quote: Loss of control. A model’s ability to undermine effective human control through adaptive, deceptive, or self-reinforcing mechanisms such that, when deployed, a model can no longer be reliably directed, modified, or shut down.

threshold.note: p.15 only says 'We are studying and progressing methods' and 'researching approaches ... setting appropriate risk acceptance criteria'; no level defined.

response.quote: If, during the implementation of this framework, we identify a risk we cannot sufficiently mitigate, we will pause development and deployment until the point at which mitigation practices evolve to meet the risk.
response.note: Generic pause gate (E3) covers any risk identified, incl. loss of control; no loss-of-control-specific response or threshold. Ambiguous.

acc_decider.note: Executive Officer decision (p.10) is framed on the low or medium risk level, and loss of control has no level or named response to decide on. Ambiguous.

acc_external.note: No binding external review covering loss of control; third-party evaluation is discretionary (p.7).

acc_unmet.note: Only the generic pause gate (p.9) applies; no named required response for loss of control, so E4 excludes it.
